description: A self-introduction ("my name is X", "I'm X and I live") inside the speaker's own turn, or an official matched by name.
A looser self-introduction inside the turn ("this is X from", "good evening, X here").
The chair names the next speaker ("our next speaker is X") and that turn starts.
No introduction in the turn: the nearest earlier introduction within 180 s (about 2,500 characters of speech) with no turn marker between. A candidate only; the name is not shown.
An introduction was heard but the name is not served (a minor, a student, a school-board resident, or not a known given name): turn confidence only.
A ">>" caption speaker-change starts the turn and no name was said: Speaker N, turn confidence only.
The chair's call ("next speaker", "please state your name") starts the turn and no name was said: Speaker N, turn confidence only.
The introduced first and last name equal exactly one current official of the meeting's own government (person_government).
An AI-extracted held_by slug whose role is an official title, not matched to the roster.
An AI-extracted held_by slug with a first and last name and no role: shown as First L.
An AI-extracted held_by slug whose name equals exactly one current official of the decision's government.
A quoted passage within 600 characters of the speaker's introduction with no caption turn marker between (meeting_passage_speaker).
A quoted passage 600 to 2500 characters after the speaker's introduction with no turn marker between (meeting_passage_speaker).
A quoted passage within 2500 characters of the chair naming the speaker (\next speaker is X\") with no turn marker between."
A quoted passage whose nearest earlier introduction has a caption turn marker between: it may be another speaker. A candidate only; the name is not shown.
